Based on the comprehensive technical analysis and your recent project updates, here is the status of your video and audio modules:
 Video Modules
OpenCV (Vision)
: This is your primary video module
.
After the initial "Red Wall" errors, it has been
successfully installed
via the
tur-repo
and linked manually to your Python 3.12 environment
. It is now active for physical orb tracking in the yard.
+1
Media3 Ecosystem (Native)
: Mentioned as a high-performance standard for video playback and hardware-accelerated transcoding (transformer API). This is typically used in the
Native Kotlin
stack for deep Android integration, rather than the Termux environment.
 Audio Modules
Oboe (C++)
: This low-level module is identified as the requirement for
real-time audio
and sub-10ms latency. It bypasses the Android Runtime (ART) to access audio buffers directly.
AAudio
: Works alongside Oboe to manage high-performance audio streams.
\ufe0f Current Status & Missing Elements
Installation Complete
: You have confirmed that everything is "round up," the "Mind's Eye" is anchored, and no more fixes are needed for the current sentinel setup.
Redundancy Check
: Your system is now running a
Dual-Stream Scan
, using visual tracking (OpenCV) and spectral logic (Mind's Eye) simultaneously.
Are you planning to add the high-performance Oboe audio drivers next, or are you staying in "Observation Mode" with the current visual and spectral setup?
